projectDescription.text: We are the county public works department in southwestern Montana, and our project is to construct a wildlife overpass along with about four miles of wildlife fencing on a two-lane rural highway where elk and mule deer are regularly struck by vehicles. The corridor connects two large blocks of national forest and is a known high-collision area for wildlife-vehicle crashes. We estimate the total project cost at $14 million, and we expect to request about $11 million in federal funds. We have completed a corridor study and secured a letter of support from the state wildlife agency. Design work on the project has not yet started.
